---
title: "Interpretation limits and publication safeguards"
---

## What is not established

FPR versus national marketing routes, product chemistry, importer responsibilities and current pricing require confirmation.

No numerical output from this repository demonstrates completed project activities, legally applicable offsets, approved registrations, project ownership, additionality, third-party verification or official organisational endorsement.

## Publication controls

The original source proposals and spreadsheets are not distributed. See [rights](../RIGHTS_AND_USE.md) and [publication checklist](../docs/PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST.md).

## Future inference

Meaningful empirical identification would require actual baseline information, dated and verified activity data, documented counterfactual assumptions, uncertainty, and relevant peer/independent review. Until then, visualisations and scenarios are explanatory only.
